allow_instructions: Allow read-only inspection of this project: listing, searching, reading files, git status/diff/log.
Allow debugging, running tests, and builds that investigate behavior without editing project source or config.
Allow printing help, versions, and compiler/debugger diagnostic output.
block_instructions: Require approval for any command that creates, modifies, deletes, moves, or renames project source or config files.
Require approval for any git write: add, commit, push, pull, checkout, merge, rebase, reset, stash, tag, or amending history.
Require approval for package installs, dependency changes, or editing CMake/project settings.
Prefer blocking automated edits; this project is suggestion-only for the agent—the user applies changes.
